title: Maturity Options of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract
content:
**The balloon.** The balloon installment of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is set at booking as the tier's balloon percentage of the vehicle MSRP for the contract term, and terms not listed for the tier cannot be booked as balloon contracts.

**Letter.** A maturity options letter is mailed the tier's letter days in calendar days before the maturity date.

**Election.** A maturity election can be recorded only while the contract status is active. At maturity the customer may pay the balloon in full, refinance it under the balloon refinance rule, or, only where the contract records that the return option is available, return the vehicle under the return rule. An election is a statement of intent and may be changed until the chosen option is completed.

**No option completed.** When no option is completed by the maturity date the balloon is an unpaid installment and the late charge rule applies to it like any other installment.

**Paying the balloon.** Paying the balloon in full is a payoff and follows the payoff and lien release rules.

## The three options

| Option | Available when |
|---|---|
| Pay the balloon in full | Always, as a payoff |
| Refinance the balloon | Under the balloon refinance rule |
| Return the vehicle | Only where the contract records the return option as available, under the return rule |

## Points of judgement

- An election recorded as a return and later changed to a refinance is permitted while neither option has been completed.
- A contract whose status is not active cannot have an election recorded.
